structured_output.counterargument: The "Winter Arc" self-improvement trend is a genuinely large, real, recurring seasonal TikTok phenomenon (~6.6M posts) that peaks around Sept-Jan, and one earlier incarnation of a Solana "Winter Arc" token verifiably reached multi-million dollar market cap (DexScreener shows a WINTER ARC pool at $5.08M historically; the packet lists that same-name original at $126k residual mcap). If this specific relaunch is perceived by pump.fun rotation bots and momentum traders as "the" seasonal Winter Arc play for this year — helped by it already being the single highest-volume Winter-named token launched in the last few minutes among 6+ simultaneous clones — the same viral mechanism that took the 2024 version to eight figures could repeat, and the near-1:1 buys-to-unique-buyers ratio suggests the current inflow is at least distributed across real distinct wallets, not one bot looping. In that world p_runner should be materially higher than baseline, not below it.
